nodes.label: Intel Trust Domain Extensions (TDX) Hardware Isolation Engine
nodes.description: Hardware-enforced confidential computing architecture providing hardware isolation for virtual machines (Trust Domains) protecting in-memory graph structures from hypervisor compromise.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Maximum Entropy Morphological Disambiguator
nodes.description: Statistical and deep-learning morphological disambiguation engine resolving word-sense ambiguity, diacritics, and POS tags for complex dialectal Arabic entity tokens.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Sparse Linear Algebra Standard for Graph Algorithms
nodes.description: Standardized C/C++ API defining graph algorithms in terms of sparse matrix and vector operations over customizable semirings for parallel traversal and ranking.

nodes.label: W3C SHACL Compact Syntax (SHACLC) Specification
nodes.description: Concise human-readable textual representation language for expressing SHACL node and property shapes without full RDF serialization overhead.

nodes.label: Post-Quantum Lattice-Based Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZK-PQC) Protocol
nodes.description: Non-interactive zero-knowledge argument protocol over Module-LWE lattices permitting verifiable graph entity assertions without revealing underlying property values.
